personal Candle

A Candle for your customer, in their wallet in seconds.

“I have a Candle gift for you.” No app to download and no CandleMe sign-up to get started. They simply scan, save, and have an easy way back to their stylist, booking, offers, products and more. They can keep it, come back later, or share it with someone else.

Your salon sets the rules

A destination is simply somewhere the Candle can take a client when they tap: your booking page, a product, an offer, loyalty program, portfolio, advice, supplier, or any other link you choose.

Each Candle can hold up to 12 destinations. Your salon decides what stays consistent across the business and what each stylist can personalize, giving clients one simple place to book again, shop, see an offer or stay connected.

What a Candle is

A relationship, ready the moment it is born.

A Candle is not a website or a saved link. It is a working digital object that is born with its own unique digital identity, attribution and history. It can carry booking, products, offers, messages, useful content and up to 12 destinations. It can be saved to a phone, returned to, shared with someone else and propagated into another unique Candle, while preserving where it came from.

What the salon gets

A relationship that keeps working after the client leaves.

Bring your salon and stylist services together inside one Candle that you can update in minutes. Clients can save it to their wallet in seconds and return whenever they want to book, shop, find directions, see an offer, or simply enjoy their Candle. Your salon stays with them, and when they share the Candle, your reach can travel with it.

Everything in one Candle

Booking, services, products, suppliers, loyalty, offers, directions, useful content and more can sit behind up to 12 destinations. Update the shared experience from your console while allowing each stylist the level of personalization you choose.

See what actually spreads

See activity by location and by stylist, including who is creating more client Candles, who is generating more onward sharing, what clients are returning to, and which destinations attract their interest. When connected systems provide the data, bookings and purchases can also be attributed.

Turn propagation into reach

Every client can keep their Candle and share it with someone else. Each new Candle has its own unique digital identity while preserving where it came from, allowing your salon, your stylists and your approved destinations to move from one relationship to the next.

Optional sponsorship

Add selected, non-competing sponsors when it makes sense and share in sponsorship revenue. Sponsorship is optional, so the Candle remains useful first.

A client can save it in seconds, come back through it, book, shop, or pass it on.

Every Candle they share can create another unique Candle connected to the path it came from, extending your salon, your stylists and your offers beyond the original client.

Pilot 1-3 salons

Start with a 1-3 salon pilot.
See results from day one.

Turn your stylists into a connected sales and relationship team without complicated onboarding. Give each location manager one clearly marked Employee Onboarding QR. Each stylist scans, identifies themselves and immediately receives a unique Candle and dashboard connected to the correct location.

For a standard salon pilot, send us the location list and manager contact for each location. An employee roster is optional, not a launch requirement.

Put your booking, products, offers and useful links inside, then watch what happens: activations, returns, sharing, destination activity and attributable results.
